recentItems.title: Kristi Noem Loses ‘Shield Of The Americas’ Role After Resigning As DHS Chief | Watch
recentItems.description:
Former US Homeland Security Secretary Kristi Noem is no longer serving as the Trump administration’s special envoy for the Shield of the Americas initiative after her designation expired in September. A State Department official confirmed that Noem remains involved in the initiative as a senior adviser to Deputy Secretary Christopher Landau. The coalition, established earlier in 2026, aims to strengthen cooperation between the United States and Latin American and Caribbean countries on economic issues and anti-cartel enforcement. Noem was appointed special envoy in March after being removed as Homeland Security Secretary amid scrutiny of her department’s management and adviser Corey Lewandowski’s influence. Despite her expired designation, she continued attending diplomatic engagements, including meetings with Ecuadorian President Daniel Noboa and other regional officials. The administration has not publicly identified a replacement for the special envoy role in the supplied report.
